# SotyRoute

> A local, explainable preflight and evidence layer for authorized security work. It scores route, host, scope, intel and evidence readiness (the SOTY Score), runs read-only host/route/evidence checks, builds mission route cards, and keeps a local audit trail. Desktop app (Tauri + Rust + React), Windows-first, 100% local. An MCP server for AI agents is planned, not implemented.

Key facts for AI tools: the app makes no LLM calls and sends no telemetry; AI agents are meant to call SotyRoute, not the reverse. Scope is meant to be operator-declared and advisory; today the Scope sub-score is still demo-based by design and no target matching exists yet. For authorized labs, owned assets and written-scope engagements only.

## Concepts

- [SOTY Score](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/soty-score.md): sub-scores, weights, deductions, states, which signals are real
- [Route Packs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/route-packs.md): the 8 workflow presets
- [Soty Agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/soty-agent.md): deterministic mission-to-route builder (no external AI)
- [Host Guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/host-guard.md): read-only host posture checks
- [Evidence model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/evidence-model.md): evidence snapshots and on-disk layout
- [BOFA Gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/bofa-gate.md): local go/no-go decision (does not launch BOFA)
- [Ethical OSINT Navigator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/descambiado/SotyRoute/main/docs/osint-navigator.md): local resource catalog with blocked-by-policy entries
